title: State of Bombay v. F.N. Balsara

content.caseIdentity: State of Bombay v. F.N. Balsara, AIR 1951 SC 318
content.holding: Upheld Bombay Prohibition Act under Entry 8, List II (intoxicating liquors); impact on imported liquor (List I Entry 41) held to be purely incidental.
content.relevance: Foundational Supreme Court application of pith and substance.
